title: Reachability drop scenario
summary: A synthetic drop in responding network blocks. It illustrates an outage signal, not a confirmed disruption or affected-user estimate.
coverage_note: All values, network contexts and timestamps are invented. Broad country/region context does not mean nationwide impact. Sampled networks are not population coverage; no independent corroboration is supplied.
aggregation: Median responsive /24 network blocks over returned five-minute time samples; baseline is the prior 24-hour median of the same synthetic block set.
uncertainty: No numerical confidence interval supplied. Collection failures and unrepresentative sampling can mislead. Cause, actor, affected people and independent corroboration are unknown.
